download_mingw_builds: download a specific version of MinGW compiler toolchain from mingw-builds repository
find_7zip: find the 7zip executable on the system via PATH or Windows registry
unpack_mingw_archive: unpack a downloaded mingw-builds archive using 7zip to a specified location
query_mingw_repository: query the mingw-builds repository to list available compiler versions, architectures, and revisions
get_mingw_root: get the root directory of a specific MinGW variant by downloading and extracting if needed
